statement.zh: 研究将奥克苏斯/BMAC 表述为中亚青铜时代绿洲复合体，马尔吉亚纳（含戈努尔）约 2200–1750 BCE 有密集定居（Hiebert 1994）。
statement.en: Research frames Oxus/BMAC as a Central Asian Bronze Age oasis complex, with dense Margiana settlement including Gonur ca. 2200–1750 BCE (Hiebert 1994).
